tasks.subject: Task 0: Shared credential-pattern module
tasks.description:
**Goal:** One stdlib-only module holding every credential pattern, split into loose and strict tiers, with placeholder suppression and a redacted `Finding` type.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/kinoforge/core/credential_patterns.py`
- Test: `tests/core/test_credential_patterns.py`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `CREDENTIAL_PATTERNS` contains every pattern from all four existing lists, strongest variant where they disagreed (`AKIA|ASIA`, full BEGIN…END PEM span)
- [ ] `STRICT_PATTERNS` is exactly the `strict=True` subset, in declaration order
- [ ] `bearer_auth` declared first so `Bearer rpa_…` redacts to `<REDACTED:bearer_auth>`
- [ ] `looks_like_placeholder` suppresses on marker words and on the `kinoforge: allow-secret` pragma
- [ ] `iter_findings` yields `Finding` whose `redacted_excerpt` contains no matched credential text
- [ ] Module imports nothing outside the stdlib and nothing from `kinoforge`

**Verify:** `pixi run python -m pytest tests/core/test_credential_patterns.py -v` → all pass


tasks.subject: Task 2: Staged-content credential scanner
tasks.description:
**Goal:** `tools/scan_secrets.py` blocks a commit whose staged content carries a strict-tier credential, respecting partial staging and skipping binary files.

**Files:**
- Create: `tools/scan_secrets.py`
- Test: `tests/tools/test_scan_secrets.py`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Scans only added lines from `git diff --cached --unified=0`; a working-tree-only credential does not block
- [ ] A credential in a staged hunk blocks with exit 1 even when the same file has unstaged edits
- [ ] Binary files produce no findings and no exception
- [ ] Placeholder-marked and pragma-marked matches do not block
- [ ] Output names `path:line pattern_name` plus a redacted excerpt; the value never appears in stdout or stderr
- [ ] Exit codes: 0 clean, 1 findings, 2 git/usage error (a git failure is never reported as clean)
- [ ] `--all-tracked` scans every `git ls-files` path, skipping non-UTF-8 files; `--stdin` scans piped text

**Verify:** `pixi run python -m pytest tests/tools/test_scan_secrets.py -v` → all pass

```json:metadata
{"files": ["tools/scan_secrets.py", "tests/tools/test_scan_secrets.py"], "verifyCommand": "pixi run python -m pytest tests/tools/test_scan_secrets.py -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["only staged added lines are scanned (partial staging respected)", "staged credential blocks even when the working tree is clean", "binary files skipped without crashing", "placeholder and pragma suppression work", "credential value never printed in output", "exit 0 clean / 1 findings / 2 git error", "--all-tracked and --stdin modes work"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Tune to zero, wire the pre-commit hook
tasks.description:
**Goal:** `scan_secrets.py --all-tracked` reports zero findings over all ~1377 tracked files, and the hook is registered so future commits are scanned.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/kinoforge/core/credential_patterns.py` (pattern/marker tuning only)
- Modify: `.pre-commit-config.yaml` (append one hook)
- Modify: whichever tracked files carry an unmarked synthetic credential

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `pixi run python tools/scan_secrets.py --all-tracked` exits 0
- [ ] No file excluded wholesale; suppression is per-line or by narrowing a pattern
- [ ] Every demotion/narrowing carries a comment saying why
- [ ] The pre-commit hook runs the scanner with staged filenames and blocks on exit 1
- [ ] A planted credential is caught by `pixi run pre-commit run scan-secrets --files <path>`, then removed
- [ ] Post-tuning regression check: a piped `AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=<40 chars>` line still exits 1

**Verify:** `pixi run python tools/scan_secrets.py --all-tracked; echo "exit=$?"` → `exit=0`

```json:metadata
{"files": [".pre-commit-config.yaml", "src/kinoforge/core/credential_patterns.py"], "verifyCommand": "pixi run python tools/scan_secrets.py --all-tracked; echo exit=$?", "acceptanceCriteria": ["--all-tracked exits 0", "no wholesale file exclusions", "tuning decisions commented", "pre-commit hook registered and proven to fire on a planted key", "strict tier still catches a real-shaped assignment after tuning"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: In-repo Claude hooks — block and scrub
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A fresh clone gets both transcript protections: a PreToolUse hook that denies credential-exfiltrating Bash, and the PostToolUse scrubber, registered in a committed `.claude/settings.json`.

**Files:**
- Create: `.claude/hooks/block_secret_reads.py`
- Create: `.claude/hooks/redact_secrets.py`
- Create: `.claude/settings.json`
- Test: `tests/hooks/test_block_secret_reads.py`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Both hooks run under bare `python3` with no PYTHONPATH, no pixi env, from any cwd
- [ ] Denies bare `env`/`printenv`, credential-variable `echo`/`printenv`, `.env` reads (not `.env.example`), `gcloud auth print-*-token`, `aws configure get …secret…`, `modal token …`
- [ ] Does NOT deny `[ -n "${HF_TOKEN:-}" ] && echo set`, `rg RUNPOD .env.example`, `env | wc -l`, `aws sts get-caller-identity`, or any non-Bash tool
- [ ] The deny reason names the safe alternative verbatim
- [ ] `redact_secrets.py` carries every shared pattern, stays fail-open, keeps the PostToolUse contract
- [ ] `.claude/settings.json` registers PreToolUse (Bash) and PostToolUse (*) with `$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR`-relative paths
- [ ] Malformed stdin fails open (exit 0, empty stdout)

**Verify:** `pixi run python -m pytest tests/hooks/test_block_secret_reads.py -v` → all pass

```json:metadata
{"files": [".claude/hooks/block_secret_reads.py", ".claude/hooks/redact_secrets.py", ".claude/settings.json", "tests/hooks/test_block_secret_reads.py"], "verifyCommand": "pixi run python -m pytest tests/hooks/test_block_secret_reads.py -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["hooks run stdlib-only under bare python3 from any cwd", "enumerated deny surface fires", "ordinary work is not denied", "deny reason teaches the safe alternative", "scrubber carries every shared pattern and stays fail-open", "settings.json registers both hooks"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```
